name: UltraTex generates relightable PBR textures from one image
title: UltraTex generates relightable PBR textures from one image
summary: UltraTex generates albedo, metallic, and roughness maps for a 3D mesh from a single reference image by conditioning a multi-view diffusion model on material semantics and controlled-light renders. The paper reports higher visual fidelity and more plausible materials than prior open-source and commercial texture methods.
